collection.description: A family disagrees about a memorial for someone who disappeared at sea.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A family wants to commemorate someone who disappeared at sea, but another relative insists a memorial means giving up hope.

choices.label: Create a memorial without declaring death

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The family honors the missing person while leaving the story open.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The search continues within reasonable limits; grief and hope coexist.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: They choose a private ritual with no grave, respecting different needs.
